title: Dunque voi non aprite?
subtitle: The Count and the Countess: recitative from Le nozze di Figaro, Act 2
note: The Count decides to break the closet door open himself
about: Score: the recitative “Dunque voi non aprite?” before No. 14 (vocal score pages 132-133, 21 bars), from Paul Klengel's piano reduction in the Breitkopf & Härtel vocal score (Edition Breitkopf 1716, about 1900), public domain.
